Durable atomic database cache and auth-rate-limit state across idle destruction

secret_references.APP_KEY: Preserve current Hetzner production key for Passport refresh-token and signed-link compatibility; explicit transfer approval required before encrypted production Worker storage
secret_references.D1_TOKEN: Non-secret internal binding marker; actual SQL_GATEWAY_TOKEN stays only in the production Worker

secret_references.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: New object credential limited to production private bucket
secret_references.WEBHOOK_RELAY_TOKEN: New production relay credential independent of admin authorization
secret_references.PASSPORT_PRIVATE_KEY: Existing Hetzner OAuth signing key; verify usage before transfer
secret_references.PASSPORT_PUBLIC_KEY: Existing Hetzner OAuth verification key; verify usage before transfer
secret_references.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY: Existing Hetzner web-push configuration; verify usage before transfer
secret_references.NIGHTWATCH_TOKEN: Existing Hetzner monitoring token; transfer approval required

scheduling.reports: every five minutes, all active due schedules
scheduling.purge_archived_families: daily at 01:30 UTC with existing retention policy
scheduling.backup_retention_and_monitoring: Separate encrypted backup bucket; 14 daily days, 8 weekly periods, 6 additional monthly periods; offsite Drive folder separate from PostgreSQL; native verification required

migration.oauth_policy: Preserve OAuth clients, codes and tokens plus existing Passport signing keys and current APP_KEY; explicit secret transfer approval is required, no silent rotation
migration.rehearsal_target_key_policy: independent key generated on Hetzner; MFA re-encryption verified there only; not approved as actual production key

rollback.before_first_d1_write: Keep D1 writers and schedulers stopped, restore origin routing, then resume only the Hetzner writer and scheduler
rollback.after_first_d1_write: Freeze both writers; capture D1 financial, webhook and delivery delta; reconcile and verify PostgreSQL before reopening it. DNS reversal alone is forbidden
rollback.queued_webhooks: Drain or durably retain every accepted event; replay only through idempotent verified handlers
rollback.duplicate_sending: Freeze old scheduler and delivery worker before enabling new scheduler and delivery worker

candidate_runtime.application_instance_cap: single fixed Durable Object name familyfunds-production
candidate_runtime.offsite_credential_isolation: Separate offsite Worker/namespace/VM; native encrypted copy and duplicate task replay passed; PHP container rejects offsite credentials

native_warm_capacity.measurement_scope: Complete authenticated dashboard HTTP responses with fresh connections; browser rendering verified separately

offsite.entrypoint: Idle shell plus fixed standalone copy CLI; Laravel/FPM/nginx never start

secret_references.FF_RCLONE_CONFIG: Approved existing familyfund_drive remote, encrypted only in familyfunds-production-offsite; never log or save locally during transfer
secret_references.BACKUP_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: Read-only backup-bucket credential for a separate offsite runner; never inject into the managed PHP VM
secret_references.BACKUP_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: Read-only backup-bucket credential for a separate offsite runner; never inject into the managed PHP VM

offsite.copy_policy: Encrypted envelopes only; immutable copy plus one-way checksum; never delete Drive history

worker_only_secret_references.SQL_GATEWAY_TOKEN: New random Worker-only credential for private outbound entrypoint; no public SQL endpoint
